title: Testcasesketch tests View
description: The test case checks the rows the data-store view derives, such as a database test asserting a view's or materialized view's results. Use accesses view instead when the test only reads fixture data through the view, and tests ux.view for a UI view.
x-dr-evidence: A database test (pgTAP results_eq, tSQLt, a dbt data test) that seeds the source tables and asserts the rows a named view or materialized view returns.
An integration test that refreshes a materialized view and asserts its aggregate values.
